items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Man, he was the head of it. George DeVoe.

ctx.x: Is there any masons over there? Yeah, they used to parade. They used to parade over here though.

No, no, the mason parade over there. They had them on the other side too. Alright, now you take the odd fella parade over there, you take your best drilling rank. Old man Sam Nanny. No, that's right. Yeah, old man Sam Nanny, well he's in the drilling rank. Now you take... Oh, what he... Man, he was the head of it. George DeVoe.
